topic.remarks: Create or extract compressed archives, optionally using symmetric or public key encryption.
Create a compressed archive optionally using encryption.

sections.section: Files can be split according to a size threshold. If specified, artifacts will be written to the output directory using a sequential numbering schema concatenated with the file extension. The split size can be specified using the --split option.
Archive output can be optionally protected using symmetric or public key encryption. Symmetric encryption is processed using the AES algorithm while asymmetric encryption uses RSA key pairs.

help.topic: Encryption type to use when writing or accessing an archive. Supported types are 'symmetric' or 'asymmetric' using the AES or RSA encryption algorithms, respectively.
For symmetric encryption, this is the AES cipher key used to create or read the archive. For RSA, this is the reader's public key when writing and private keys when reading.
Compression type used to read/write archives, either GZip or Brotli algorithms (defaults to GZip).
One or more directories where archive source files are matched. When omitted, the current working directory is searched.
Directory the output artifacts are written to. When omitted, output is written to the current working directory.
One or more patterns of file names to include in the archive (supports recursive glob patterns).
Maximum size of any output file expressed in the format <size<b|k|m|g>> (defaults to 250k).
Overwrite any existing files with the same name.
One or more metadata keys to include in the manifest file.
Verbosity of output logging (trace, debug, or info).
